rationale: A solid (filled) star in an outline family. QualityCritic has no fill-style check for icons; iconsmith.icon_structural_issues exempts 'currentcolor' fills, which is exactly what a solid-style icon uses, so even the family rule is silent. Score 10. Check: any shape with fill not 'none' (currentColor included) whose area exceeds a dot (r > 1.5) in an outline family.
folded: implemented as a measurable check; kind changed from gaming to defect
